title: Common problems with 1.3.4
author: Raspberry
content:
Problems and their fixes:
misisng libc++shared.so: you have a pirated copy, buy the game.
"We only support 26.30": typo, update both flarial and minecraft.
Shaders not working: shader's fault, not us, wait till those shader makers update their pack to work on 26.40.
Missing Pack Changer/Button Scaler: temporarily disabled.

title: Important Announcement
author: Flarial Development
content:
You may see "Flarial" on the Google Play Store by "Venant Print" (some french based printing).
(package name "com.flarialfff.diomondeemote")

We are reminding you that this is a FAKE flarial listing, it does not have the client itself.
Yes, we've been trying to push to getting Flarial back on the Google Play Store.
HOWEVER, it will be distributed under the Flarial Development developer account.
(the old listing was under "Ashank" but we wasn't able to bring that back)

So PLEASE, if you encounter the fake app on the Google Play Store, report the app.
